title: GROK-EDGE-TRIAGE-R1
universal_lens: All three edges exploit internal market inefficiencies through "devigged distribution extraction": the alt-ladder devolves to a full probability density; alt-arbs reveal cross-leg consistency errors; and discrete margin spikes expose misaligned continuous pricing. They are all instances of "market microstructure arbitrage"—using a book's own derivatives to calibrate its core line, independent of vig and bettor limits.
gsi_mapping: GSI consumes these signals as "book conviction scores" and "discrete distortion metrics", feeding them into a hierarchical Bayes update of the central line estimate. The posterior uncertainty quantifies how much the book's ladder deviates from a coherent risk-neutral measure, providing a data-driven width for conformal prediction intervals.
gse_mapping: GSE uses these primitives to construct a "state-transition kernel" for simulated betting trajectories. When the book's alt-ladder exhibits a "kinky" deviation, the transition kernel jumps to a new state where the implied volatility surface is recalibrated using the extracted distribution. This models the book's dynamic updating behavior and generates synthetic data for reinforcement learning.

primitives.assumptions: The true margin distribution has sharp Dirac deltas at key numbers (3, 7, etc.), while the book's continuous pricing is smooth and linear.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Large residuals occur near the delta peaks, indicating that the linear approximation breaks down at these critical points.

layer2.telemetry: Mean squared error of the continuous fit at the key number spikes.

All three primitives exploit the redundancy in a book's derivative markets (alt lines, alt totals) to extract a more granular, "cleaner" estimate of the underlying probability measure than the single headline line. By focusing on internal consistency rather than cross-book relative value, they bypass the vig and bettor limits that make traditional betting edges transitory. The key duality is between the book's stated pricing logic (which may be ad-hoc or inconsistent) and the true risk-neutral measure it implicitly represents. Failure mode: if the book systematically ignores certain derivative products, the extracted signals will be biased.
